CustomField.description: Caps how many callout/tool-call round trips AIAgentManager will make in a single turn before giving up, so a model that keeps requesting tools can't loop indefinitely. Agents configured with more tools, or tools that often chain together, may need a higher ceiling than a simple single-lookup agent.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set a ceiling on tool-calling round trips per turn for this Agent.
CustomField.label: Max Tool Calling Iterations
